heroHeadline: Day 949: Likud Quietly Strips 'Full, Thorough, and Independent' Language from Oct. 7 Inquiry Bill — October Council: 'Political Whitewash'; 49 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 13, 2026 (Day 949 / Ceasefire Day 216), during a Knesset Constitution, Law, and Justice Committee meeting, it emerged that MK Ariel Kallner (Likud) had quietly removed the phrase 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from the purpose clause of the coalition's Oct. 7 inquiry bill. The deletion was flagged by the committee's own legal adviser; Kallner claimed it was only for conciseness — rejected by opposition and bereaved family groups. Under the revised bill, a politically appointed six-member committee could give Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana (Likud) authority to fill opposition slots if the opposition boycotts — which all opposition parties have announced. The October Council (bereaved families forum) declared the bill a 'political whitewash committee,' and simultaneously condemned Netanyahu's High Court filing as proof 'he alone is responsible for Oct. 7 failures.' The revelations came one day after the Civil Commission published its landmark 'Silenced No More' final report (May 12) — documenting that October 7 sexual violence was systematic, widespread, and integral to Hamas strategy, based on 10,000+ images/videos and 430+ testimonies. 49 days remain to the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 deadline. Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved accountability wound at the heart of Israeli politics. Gaza ceasefire remains highly volatile: Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza, Hamas holds firm on disarmament refusal, 850+ Palestinians killed since October 2025 ceasefire, IDF operational plans for resumed offensive complete pending US authorization.
